title: fix(app-shell, plugins): hosted-console UX defects from the 2026-09-28 cloud E2E (six of seven)
body:
Refs #10899 — six of its seven items land here; item 4 needs a maintainer decision and the replay-ordering half of item 5 is root-caused but not changed, so the card stays open.

Part of objectstack-ai/cloud#2440

Clause-②: no

One commit per item, each with its own test, ablation and changeset. Session `https://claude.ai/code/session_786273a0-0246-4bb2-b026-bb37ba5d7295` (dispatch branch `claude/issue-10899-hosted-console-ux-defects`).

## Verdict per item

| # | Item | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Assistant FAB covers the dock's send button | **done** — the FAB renders only while the dock is collapsed (`ConsoleLayout`) |
| 2 | Failed record comment shown as sent | **done** (objectui half of cloud#2431, per the ruling that cloud mounts audit on hosted tenants) — a comment/reply lands only after its `sys_comment` write resolves; a failed write shows a localized toast and the composer keeps the draft |
| 3 | Dashboard 403 renders as a raw English exception | **done** — `queryDataset` throws a typed `AnalyticsForbiddenError` for 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`; `DatasetWidget` renders a localized no-access state. The missing grant itself is cloud#2439 |
| 4 | Assistant scope chip says 「新建应用」 inside an app | **open — needs a maintainer decision** (below). Not changed here |
| 5 | Empty 「执行过程」 blocks; replay orders steps differently | **empty blocks: done**. **Ordering: root-caused, producer outside this change** (below). Not changed here |
| 6 | Studio edit/design offered to a non-platform-admin | **done — the producer is the console**. The server's permission answer is already right; the console ignored it |
| 7 | Marketplace labels an older version as an update | **done** — "update" means higher SemVer 2.0.0 precedence, at both call sites |

## What each commit does

- **Item 7** — `versionPrecedence.ts` orders two versions by SemVer 2.0.0 §11 (the grammar the package manifest declares for `version`). `cloudUpdateAvailable` and the install dialog's per-environment `hasUpdate` both use `isNewerVersion` instead of `!==`. Non-SemVer or equal pairs offer no update.
- **Item 1** — the FAB is the dock's collapsed affordance (ADR-0057 open question 2). `ConsoleLayout` now renders it only while `dock.expanded` is false, which is the rule `ChatDockLauncher` already follows.
- **Item 6** — the page pencil (`PageView`) and the top-bar hammer (`AppHeader`) required only the workspace-admin role, and an org owner holds that role. Both now also require `manage_metadata` through `useCanAuthorMetadata`, which reads `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions`. HomePage's builder CTAs already use the same check. If the server reports no `systemPermissions`, the check fails open, so older servers keep the admin-only behaviour.
  - Measured producer: on the PM's rig control DB (read-only), the signed-up owner holds `cloud_control_plane_member` (no system permissions) and `organization_admin_no_bypass` = `manage_org_users, setup.access, setup.write`. Framework's `organization_admin` withholds `manage_metadata` on purpose. So the server's answer was correct and the console did not read it.
- **Item 2** — `RecordDetailView` no longer adds optimistic rows. It awaits the `create`, then appends the row. On failure it shows `toast.error(detail.commentFailed)` (new key, all ten packs) and rejects back to the caller.
  - The three composers (`RecordActivityTimeline`, `ThreadedReplies`, `RecordComments`) now handle a rejected `onAddComment` / `onAddReply` explicitly: they keep the draft. Before this, the throw escaped as an unhandled rejection.
  - `RecordDetailView.feedRecordScope.test.tsx` had a case that asserted the opposite of the ruling ("keeps an unpersisted comment when the write never lands"). It is rewritten to the ruled behaviour.
- **Item 3** — `queryDataset` gains a code-based branch for the analytics read admission's `403` + `PERMISSION_DENIED` (`readAdmissionDeniedError` in `@objectstack/service-analytics`). The new `AnalyticsForbiddenError` carries `httpStatus: 403` and `code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED'`. `DatasetWidget` classifies the error with the shared `classifyLoadError`, the same classifier the list view uses. For `forbidden` it renders `dashboard.widgetForbiddenTitle` / `widgetForbiddenMessage` (new, all ten packs). A 403 with no code keeps the generic error.
- **Item 5 (empty blocks)** — a reloaded build hydrates one assistant message per persisted step, and each step's text is the `(called …)` placeholder. `ChatbotEnhanced` now shows the 执行过程 note only when the turn shows no tool row and no build or design panel. The copy/regenerate bar renders only for a turn with visible prose. The #772 fallback, where a placeholder turn with nothing else keeps its note, is preserved and pinned.

## Item 4 — why it is not changed here

The in-app dock runs the build agent on an app-less, product-only conversation scope (`ChatDock.tsx`, `chatConversationScope` with no `appId`). It sends no package binding. So in ADR-0057 Amendment A1's terms the chip is telling the truth: the thread is unbound, and "New app" is the unbound label. A1.b also records the dock keeping the legacy product-only key as a decision. Making the chip name the current app means either:

- **A** — bind the dock's build thread to the current app's package (`editPackageId` + `app:PKG:build` scope). The agent then gets a declared write target, and the dock, `/ai/build?package=` and the Studio copilot share one thread. This reverses the A1.b decision.
- **B** — relabel the unbound chip. The agent would still guess the target app.

Recommendation: A, for the build product only, and only when the active app is an authorable package. Details are in the report on the card. It changes a decided ADR line, so it waits for the maintainer.

## Item 5 — replay ordering (measured, not changed)

I read the rig tenant DB (`ai_messages`, read-only). The follow-up proposal turn (EFYj) was still persisting its last `todo_write` and final prose at 04:36:42–44Z. The user's 「确认，开始搭建。」 (turn dh2L) was persisted at 04:36:39Z. The conversation store orders by `created_at, id` across turns (cloud `packages/service-ai/src/conversation/objectql-conversation-service.ts`, `MESSAGE_ORDER`). The replay therefore puts the confirm message inside the previous turn's steps, while the live run showed that turn whole.

Two things contribute:
- the store orders by time, not by turn (cloud);
- the plan card's build button stays clickable while its own turn is still streaming (`ChatbotEnhanced`).

Both are named in the report.

## Tests

All runs are on HEAD `d8969d4bc` unless noted.

- New pins (one per item, each ablated — revert the fix → red, restore → `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - item 7: `versionPrecedence-10899.test.ts`, `MarketplacePackagePage.updateIsHigherVersion-10899.test.tsx` (ablation: 1 failed)
  - item 1: `ConsoleLayout.fabYieldsToOpenDock-10899.test.tsx` (1 failed)
  - item 6: `PageView.editInStudioNeedsAuthoring-10899.test.tsx`, `AppHeader.designInStudioNeedsAuthoring-10899.test.tsx` (2 failed)
  - item 2: `RecordDetailView.commentWriteFailure-10899.test.tsx` + the rewritten feed-scope case (3 failed). Composer half: `composerKeepsDraftOnRejection-10899.test.tsx` — with the `catch` removed, the run exits 1 on unhandled rejections while the draft assertions still pass. Keeping the draft used to be an accident of the throw.
  - item 3: `queryDataset.forbidden-10899.test.ts`, `DatasetWidget.forbiddenState-10899.test.tsx` (2 failed)
  - item 5: `ChatbotEnhanced.hydratedStepTurns-10899.test.tsx` (2 failed)
- Package suites: one `vitest run` over `packages/app-shell/ packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/plugin-dashboard/ packages/data-objectstack/ packages/plugin-detail/ packages/i18n/` — `Test Files 1409 passed | 2 skipped (1411)`, `Tests 14850 passed | 23 skipped (14873)`, exit 0
- Build: `turbo run build` for the six touched packages plus the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure — 29/29 successful.
- Type-check: `turbo run type-check` for the six packages — 6/6 successful.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence` (6 changesets for 6 packages), `check-changeset-no-major` — all exit 0.
- Lint, narrowed to this diff: `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 33 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files. For every pre-existing file, the error/warning counts at HEAD equal its counts at the merge base (the only errors are 4 pre-existing `no-console` in `data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, 4/127 → 4/127). New files have 0 errors. Type-aware linting is not enabled, so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide lint belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- ⚠️ The shared verify lock was **not taken**: the wrapper reported `UNLOCKED (declared) · no usable flock on this host`. Build, type-check and suites ran unserialized.
- NOT MEASURED: an in-browser check of the six fixes. The PM's rig was observed through its screenshots and read-only DB reads only — no sign-in, no writes.
- Out of scope, noted and not filed:
  - `handleToggleReaction` still swallows a failed reaction write (same optimistic shape as item 2; no carrier).
  - The reply input (`ThreadedReplies`) renders only under an item with `replyCount > 0`, and no feed read sets that, so a loaded discussion offers no reply affordance.
  - Other admin-role-only authoring affordances (view add/rename/delete in `ObjectView`, the report editor, `ObjectDataPage`) do not read `manage_metadata`. Same class as item 6, not measured on the control plane.
  - `ObjectChart`'s dataset path, `DatasetReportRenderer` and `DashboardFilterBar` still print the (now typed, English) refusal message instead of a localized state.
- Changesets: six, all `patch`.
